trap.label: that-clause
trap.wrong: The fact what plastic stays is scary.
trap.right: The fact that plastic stays is scary.
trap.why: Em português “o fato de que”; o brasileiro troca por what ou of. Substantivo + that-clause: the fact that, the idea that.

mcq.q: The fact **___** plastic lasts is scary.
The idea **___** it is safe is wrong.

opts: The belief that taxes rise worries me.
The belief what taxes rise worries me.
The belief of taxes rise worries me.

mcq.q: The news **___** the factory closed shocked us.

fix.wrong: The idea of that it is safe is wrong.
fix.right: The idea that it is safe is wrong.

fix.wrong: The fact what he lied is clear.
fix.right: The fact that he lied is clear.

fix.wrong: The news what he left surprised me.
fix.right: The news that he left surprised me.

rewrite.prompt: Una: “Plastic stays. It is scary.” (The fact that…)
rewrite.answer: The fact that plastic stays is scary.

rewrite.prompt: Una: “It is safe. The idea is wrong.” (The idea that…)
rewrite.answer: The idea that it is safe is wrong.

rewrite.prompt: Una: “The factory closed. The news shocked us.” (The news that…)
rewrite.answer: The news that the factory closed shocked us.
